what: A slick carousel in which a center cell (default 726px) stands in the middle of the panel and the side cells are cropped at the panel edge advances one cell every 5 seconds over .5s, endlessly. The arrows (40px dark squares) overlap both corners of the center cell’s photo by 22px, and on hover an inverted button turns on in .4s (.7s on release). Five dots below (10px outlined circles — the current cell is filled), it also advances by drag or swipe, and on cell hover the photo scales 1.05 in .4s. On narrow screens (below 769px) one cell fills the panel and the arrows sit 30px from the panel edge

options.delay: Time to the next slide (ms), default 5000 — 0 means no auto-advance, only buttons, dots and drag
options.speed: Duration per slot shift (ms), default 500 — 0 is instant
options.edge: Distance to place the arrows outward from the center cell corner (px), default -22 (the 40px button half overlaps the corner)
options.narrow: Below this width (px) a single column fills the panel, default 769
options.swipe: Drag ratio counted as a swipe (slick touchThreshold), default 10
options.--fx-slide: Column width on wide screens (css), default 726px
options.--fx-arrow-in · --fx-arrow-out: Duration (css) for the flipped arrow turning on and off, default .4s · .7s
options.--fx-zoom · --fx-zoom-dur: Photo scale and duration (css) when hovering a cell, default 1.05 · .4s
options.--fx-dots-gap · --fx-dots-gap-narrow: Margin below the dot rows (css), default 36px · 25.5px
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Cell (direct child of the board) — put only cells in. Slick adds the clones
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: (if present) photo frame inside the cell — centers the arrow height on this frame and scales up the first child

note: Load slick 1.8.1 (_vendor/slick-carousel@1.8.1) and jQuery first, and load slick.css too. The arrows are empty buttons inserted by the component (.slick-prev·.slick-next), and the chevron is drawn with a 7px diagonal gradient on the button background and the hover overlay (::after) — the only value that changes on hover is the overlay opacity (same as the original)
